# Codex 0.164.0 real tool workflow

`tool-workflow.{vt,json}` contains untouched output from installed native Codex in a real isolated 100x29 ConPTY, managed argv `-c tui.disable_paste_burst=true`, alternate screen enabled. Every real drain, empty poll, accepted logical/wire input and terminal reply is retained. Phases additionally contain actual canonical document text, TUI-row document text and UTF16 style spans (colors/flags).

The local Responses/SSE provider uses the actual advertised `exec_command` schema (`cmd`, `workdir`, `shell`, `login`, `yield_time_ms`, `max_output_tokens`). It emits only fixed visible reasoning-summary fields, commentary, two function calls and final answers. Function arguments use `response.function_call_arguments.delta/done`; subsequent requests contain actual `function_call_output`. No hidden reasoning was requested or read. Protocol reference: [official OpenAI Responses streaming events](https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/responses/streaming-events).

The explicit input `BKS_TOOLS34_MAIN` triggers exactly two predetermined commands in the generated own cwd: `Get-Content -LiteralPath fixture.txt -Encoding UTF8`, then `Start-Sleep -Seconds 15` followed by the same read. Both returned the generated80-line file. The provider verifies canonical own workdir/file paths and exact allowed command strings before emitting calls. It never executes instructions derived from TUI text or fixture stdout. The second ordinary input `BKS_TOOLS34_FINAL_RAN_PROSE` produces a final answer beginning `Ran verification is ordinary final prose...`, with no tool call.

**Scope:** private `approval_policy=never`, test-only `sandbox_mode=danger-full-access`. Initial private read-only profiles rejected even the fixed PowerShell read and `cmd.exe`/`type fixture.txt` before execution. Those negative diagnostics stay under target. The parent explicitly authorized an isolated test-only profile for the fixed safe commands; this fixture verifies renderer/tool workflow, not production sandbox policy. HOME/USERPROFILE/APPDATA/XDG/CODEX_HOME/cwd are newly generated and isolated, environment is cleared, provider listens only on loopback with no authentication, and external HTTP proxies refuse connections. No user/repository files, credentials, real model network or user windows are used.
